findings.title: Fresh prospect-list denial leaves cached cards and pipeline usable
reproduction: Load the prospect index with one authorized synthetic prospect.
Open the prospect, expire the 30-second query freshness interval, and make the list endpoint return 403.
Return using the Prospects breadcrumb. The current 403 alert appears, but the prior name, geography, stage and next action remain rendered.
The Pipeline button remains enabled and opens those cached records despite the denied current list read.
findings.observed: QueryState displays the fresh permission denial while the list/count/pipeline branches use query.data without checking query.error or successful current access.
findings.expected: A denied list read must withhold the stale records and dependent pipeline actions until access is successfully re-established.
findings.deploymentImpact: Fix before enabling the authenticated Prospects list. This is a frontend revocation-display failure involving previously delivered data; no server authorization bypass, cross-tenant fetch or successful unauthorized mutation was demonstrated.
findings.figmaEvidenceMeaning: Actual411:44335 confirms the pipeline is a view of prospect records. The denial requirement is grounded in repository authorization/failure standards; the design does not itself specify403 behavior.

findings.title: Typing during a prospect document save is silently lost on success
reproduction: Open a manual document in the prospect-scoped Workspace.
Enter First submitted text and click Save draft; hold the synthetic PATCH response.
The Body field remains editable, so enter Later typed text that must survive.
Release the valid PATCH and snapshot responses. The field resets to First submitted text; the later edit is neither submitted nor retained.
findings.observed: The text controls accept edits while the request is pending. Clearing retained state changes the DraftEditor key and reloads it from saved content, discarding newer local input.
findings.expected: Freeze the fields during the save or retain post-submit edits as unsaved changes across the successful save/reload.
findings.deploymentImpact: Fix before enabling prospect manual document editing: normal typing during a slow successful save silently loses user work. This is independent of native transaction/CAS limitations and reproduces with valid successful service receipts.
findings.figmaEvidenceMeaning: Actual document frames establish an editable document workflow. The defect affects the currently implemented manual editor, regardless of the separately missing rich-formatting controls.

findings.title: Prospect Files cannot search the loaded file list
reproduction: Open a prospect with a current scoped attachment list containing a ready synthetic file.
Inspect the Files region: Preview and Download are present, but neither a searchbox nor a search-labelled textbox exists.
Compare actual Figma 411:65071, which provides Search files above the file table.
findings.observed: The component directly maps all returned files into an unfiltered list and supplies no search state or control.
findings.expected: Provide the search interaction for available prospect files without widening the authorized source.
findings.deploymentImpact: Blocks the search facet of PROS-019 and full Files design acceptance. It does not block the already implemented upload/readiness/open facets or establish a native storage failure.
